text:
ashley: CI alert from nightly: microbench/concurrent-batch (PR: https://repo/PR/21321) crossed threshold +3.7% p50 vs main. Failing job: perf-unit-merge.
ci-bot: Detected threshold diff: p50 +3.7%, p95 +8.9%. Artifacts: https://ci/artifacts/7999997777.
sara: ack — repro locally on my x86 perf harness. Seems reproducible with sequence-length 512 and 8 concurrent workers.
ben: seeing KV cache hit drop in the same run: kv_hit_rate went from ~92% -> ~61% in the failing trace. attaching kv telemetry: kv_hits=610k kv_misses=390k.
miguel: uploaded a flamegraph and contention profile: https://ci/graphs/7999997777/flame.svg. top hot spot is kernel_dispatcher::choose_kernel locked section.
ashley: here's the suspicious change from the PR (commit 0a1b2c) — they added a coarse lock around kernel selection to 'stabilize' autoselect:
```\n// kernel_dispatcher.cpp
std::lock_guard<std::mutex> g(selector_mutex);
auto k = select_kernel(model, seq_len);
// do everything under the lock to avoid races
```
ben: that lock serializes selection across workers. with batching and KV warmups it's causing head-of-line and preventing concurrent cache priming. explains p50 and kv hit drop.
sara: local experiment: removed the lock => p50 back to baseline and kv_hit_rate back to ~90%. non-deterministic races not observed in my harness.
ashley: plan options: (1) revert the commit in PR 21321 (fast), (2) change to per-model RW lock or per-worker cache of selected kernel (safer), (3) add finer-grained locking only around kernel metadata load.
ci-bot: rerun requested: triggered try job with revert patch: https://ci/try/7999997780 (queued).
miguel: i can prototype per-worker cache in a small patch today: store last_selected_kernel in thread-local and validate staleness with epoch counter. should remove global contention.
qa-bot: add perf unit to catch >1.5% p50 regressions on microbench/concurrent-batch for future PRs. filing ticket: https://issues/RED-4567.
ashley: since this blocks the release rollout, i propose we revert now and follow up with miguel's patch & unit test. who can make the revert PR?
ben: i'll open the revert PR in 5m and tag @ashley for review.
sara: once revert lands, let's run the full perf suite across gpu and cpu CI lanes.
ci-bot: try job with revert completed: p50 delta -0.1% (within noise), kv_hit_rate 91% — looks green.
ashley: great, i'm landing revert PR and marking original PR as draft until the per-worker solution + tests are in. adding rollout hold on 2026-03-20 release. :white_check_mark:
ben: noted. follow-ups: add perf regression test, add comment in kernel selector impl about concurrency assumptions, and add an integration job that runs concurrent-batch on larger pool.
miguel: i'll push an experimental patch with thread-local cache + epoch guard, will post perf numbers tomorrow.
ashley: thanks all. keeping this thread for postmortem notes and linking to the bisect artifacts.
ci-bot: archived try artifacts: https://ci/artifacts/7999997782 (revert) and https://ci/artifacts/7999997777 (failing).
